title: Presidents of ANAS
subtitle: Leaders guiding the Academy across decades

people.name: Mir Asadulla Mirgasimov
people.bio: Mirgasimov helped define the Academy's early structure and ensured medical sciences had a clear research mandate.

people.name: Yusif Mammadaliyev
people.summary: Chemist of petroleum catalysis; served two non-consecutive terms.
people.bio: Mammadaliyev advanced catalysis research and linked academic work with national energy priorities.

people.name: Zahid Khalilov
people.summary: Mathematician of functional analysis and institutional growth leader.
people.bio: Khalilov expanded the Academy's mathematics programs and emphasized international collaboration.

people.name: Hasan Abdullayev
people.summary: Physicist in semiconductors and solid-state; longest-serving Soviet-era president.
people.bio: Abdullayev invested in physical sciences infrastructure, growing labs that still anchor research output.

people.name: Mahmud Karimov
people.summary: Physicist who modernized radiation physics and radioecology research.
people.bio: Karimov prioritized modernization and international visibility for Academy scientists.

people.name: Isa Habibbayli
people.bio: Habibbayli focuses on humanities and sciences integration and strategic partnerships for the Academy's future.
